name: PancakeSwap V3 Factory

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: Factory.owner() is a UUPS proxy wrapper whose own owner is a plain 3-of-6 Safe - the same Safe PancakeSwap uses as a 3-of-7 on Ethereum/Arbitrum/Base/BSC, one owner short here.
narrative.detail: Deterministic CREATE3 address shared with every other PancakeSwap V3 chain (sourced from PancakeSwap’s own official docs, not a lookalike). The Safe controls both factory ownership and upgrades of the wrapper itself - no timelock found anywhere in the chain.
